title: Centralized Design Repository (/design) + design-function process repoint
name: UIUX Design Centralization
description: Andrew-direct #7 (2026-07-15): stand up workspace-root /design as THE centralized repository for all brand guideline materials, component design, and archetypal patterns -- cross-platform client-facing product + design (portal = primary surface today; grows to other surfaces, particularly client-side integrations). Part A (infrastructural): assess all design-informing files and duplicate-or-move them into /design with SCALABLE, explicitly anti-sprawl folder design ('do not want to design for markdown sprawl and deprecation') -- one canonical copy per concern, tombstone-pointer stubs at old paths, living code (tokens/themes) POINTED AT never copied. Part B (process): audit every process architecture that relies on design functions -- tier-3 RD agents, scripting that adjusts design/client-side UX, skills -- and repoint them at /design.
